root_cause.text: A copy-paste error in `tcf_blockcast_redir()` causes the `mac_header_xmit` flag to be queried from the next device (`dev`) instead of the current target device (`dev_prev`), leading to incorrect MAC header push/pull decisions and potential skb corruption.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `dev_is_mac_header_xmit(dev)` to `dev_is_mac_header_xmit(dev_prev)` in the loop; the commit message explicitly states that "the loop sends to dev_prev but queries dev_is_mac_header_xmit(dev) — which is the NEXT device" and that the last device is handled correctly, confirming the oversight.
